The later GitHub transport copied that stale assumption and its synthetic test workspace hid both the missing current file and the fact that every live GitHub checkout contains .git.
causal_chain: B28 removes PHASE_CANDIDATE_MANIFEST.json from the authoritative source tree.

The live GitHub transport independently requests the same deleted path before it can build repository metadata.
The evaluator recursively classifies .git as a forbidden runtime directory even though GitHub Actions checkout creates it.
Therefore current main cannot pass the admission boundary even when repository protection, Environment, and secret presence are valid.
